review_basis.method: Independent local visual review of 1-second and multi-second frame samples after the single Vertex response
review_basis.audio_note: No useful spoken narration was identified. Local volume measurement found a very low mean level (-52.6 dB), although isolated peaks were present.

overall_workflow: A transparent rigid hexagonal template is positioned on a larger hexagonal fabric piece and secured with two pins. The fabric margin is folded around the template and the overlapping corner folds are secured with hand stitches while the piece is rotated. Near the end, the thread is finished/cut, the pins are removed, and the prepared hexagonal unit is shown and placed down.

directly_visible_facts: A larger pink hexagonal fabric piece and a smaller transparent rigid hexagonal template are already aligned on the work surface.
Two loose headed pins are visible beside the piece.
reasonable_instructional_interpretation: The fabric extending beyond the template provides the margin that will be folded around it.
uncertain_inference: Which face of the fabric is the right or wrong side cannot be established confidently from the image.
unsupported_assumptions_not_to_state: The exact fabric composition, dimensions, seam-allowance width, template brand, or product name.

directly_visible_facts: The piece is lifted and handled while the transparent template remains aligned with the fabric.
Two headed pins are inserted through openings in the template to secure the layers.
reasonable_instructional_interpretation: The pins reduce movement of the template during folding and stitching.
unsupported_assumptions_not_to_state: That two pins are universally required for every template or project.

directly_visible_facts: The fabric margin is folded over successive straight edges of the template.
At successive corners, overlapping folded fabric layers are caught with hand stitches.
The rigid template itself is not visibly pierced.
The piece is repeatedly rotated as the maker progresses around it.
A green finger protector or thimble-like aid is used during stitching.
reasonable_instructional_interpretation: These are securing or basting stitches at the folded corners rather than a continuous seam around every edge.
Keeping the fold close to the template supports a clean geometric shape.
uncertain_inference: The exact stitch count and exact thread-finishing method are obscured by the hands and motion.
unsupported_assumptions_not_to_state: A fixed stitch count, precise tension, specific needle/thread type, or measured seam allowance.

directly_visible_facts: The final thread handling is completed and the thread is cut with small scissors.
The two securing pins are removed.
The transparent template remains inside the folded fabric at this point.
reasonable_instructional_interpretation: The pinning phase is complete because the folded and stitched fabric now retains the template.
uncertain_inference: Exact transition times are approximate because the hands and motion blur briefly obscure the thread and pins.
unsupported_assumptions_not_to_state: When or how the template will later be removed; that later operation is not shown.

directly_visible_facts: The prepared hexagonal piece is briefly shown and placed face-up on the cutting mat.
reasonable_instructional_interpretation: This is the end state of the preparation demonstrated in the clip.
unsupported_assumptions_not_to_state: The next construction step or that the piece is immediately ready for a particular joining method.
